newsitem.title: USA: Ticketmaster begins Broadway ticket service online.
newsitem.headline: Ticketmaster begins Broadway ticket service online.

text.p: Ticketmaster Corp said Monday that it has begun offering online ticket sales for Broadway performances.

Ticketmaster, which has filed a registration to go public in November under Ticketmaster Group Inc, said Ticketmaster Online features seating charts to let customers choose seats and confirm orders. The preferred method of payment is through MasterCard, the company said.

The online service began about a month ago in Washington and Oregon, and Ticketmaster plans to finish adding other New York sites by the end of October, said Alan Citron, the company's senior vice president of new media.
"By early '97 we should be able to sell tickets (online) all over the country," Citron said.
Ticketmaster had about $1.6 billion in gross ticket sales last year, Citron said.
To launch Ticketmaster Online, the company is holding a sweepstakes offering a trip to New York and smaller prizes.
